tickets.title: Obtain home safety modification estimates
tickets.text: Collect contractor estimates for the home safety modifications recommended by Owen Pebblefizz's discharge therapist, including grab bars, stair rail changes, and a shower entry modification, so the figures can be included in the household cash-flow plan.
tickets.evidence: The discharge therapist recommended grab bars, stair rail changes, and a shower entry modification, but no contractor estimates have been collected for the cash-flow plan;

tickets.title: Gather long-term care claim materials
tickets.text: Obtain the full policy, elimination-period ledger, physician certification form, and current claim packet for Owen Pebblefizz's Velvet Acorn Life & Care long-term care claim; the household currently holds only the benefit brochure for the $165 daily home-care benefit with a 90 service-day elimination period.
tickets.evidence: The household has the benefit brochure but not the full policy, elimination-period ledger, physician certification form, or current claim packet for Owen’s home-care claim;

tickets.title: Assemble Medicare home-health denial packet
tickets.text: Assemble the appeal packet for the two denied therapy visits under Owen Pebblefizz's Silver Marmot Health Medicare Advantage plan, including the therapy notes and homebound certification from the explanation of benefits Nadia brought, given the short appeal window.
tickets.evidence: Nadia brought an explanation of benefits showing two denied therapy visits and said the appeal window is short, while the therapy notes and homebound certification are not yet assembled; the agreed follow-up is to assemble the Medicare home-health denial packet by 2026-08-19.

tickets.title: Prepare caregiver compensation framework
tickets.text: Prepare a framework for compensating Lila Pebblefizz for part of her unpaid evening care of Owen Pebblefizz, covering documentation, tax reporting, and boundaries between gifts and paid care.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare a caregiver compensation framework by 2026-09-05.

tickets.title: Follow up on care agency authorization contacts
tickets.text: Follow up with Paper Otter Home Care to update the authorized signer for schedule changes, since Owen Pebblefizz is still listed as the only authorized signer despite Nadia Pebblefizz managing his appointments after the hospitalization.
tickets.evidence: Paper Otter Home Care still lists Owen as the only authorized signer for schedule changes, which conflicts with Nadia’s role managing his appointments after the hospitalization; follow-up on care agency authorization contacts remains needed.

tickets.title: Prepare care-cost cash-flow projection
tickets.text: Prepare a twelve-month projection for Nadia and Owen Pebblefizz comparing current home-health hours, adult day care, and the quoted respite setting against pension income, Social Security, taxable-account cash, and possible IRA distribution sources.
tickets.evidence: Nadia requested a twelve-month projection comparing current home-health hours, adult day care, and the quoted respite setting against pension income, Social Security, taxable-account cash, and possible IRA distribution sources. The agreed follow-up is to prepare the care-cost cash-flow projection by

tickets.title: Address benefit changes from reduced work
tickets.text: Analyze for Nadia Pebblefizz how losing her roughly $2,100 per month Cloudberry Kite Rehabilitation consulting income would affect the monthly care budget and estimated tax payments, since she expects to stop consulting by the end of 2026 if Owen's care needs continue.
tickets.evidence: Nadia’s consulting income may stop if caregiving demands continue, and she asked how losing that income would affect the monthly care budget and estimated tax payments; the agreed follow-up is to address benefit changes from reduced work by 2026-09-11.

tickets.title: Address recurring transfer failure
tickets.text: Resolve the failed recurring $5,000 monthly transfer from the Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account to the Teacup Comet Bank checking account, which holds $22,400 as of 2026-08-14, while Paper Otter Home Care has marked the latest invoice as past due.
tickets.evidence: The Teacup Comet Bank checking account did not receive the scheduled transfer from Velvet Acorn Custody, and Paper Otter Home Care marked the latest invoice as past due. The agreed follow-up is to address the recurring transfer failure by 2026-08-21.

tickets.title: Reconcile home-care invoice
tickets.text: Reconcile the Paper Otter Home Care invoice against the family care log for Owen Pebblefizz, which shows more billed visits than the log and one overnight shift billed under a weekend premium rate Nadia Pebblefizz did not recognize.
tickets.evidence: The Paper Otter Home Care invoice shows more billed visits than the family care log, and one overnight shift appears under a weekend premium rate that Nadia did not recognize; the agreed follow-up is to reconcile the home-care invoice by 2026-08-23.

tickets.title: Prepare liquidity plan after portfolio review
tickets.text: Prepare a liquidity plan for Nadia and Owen Pebblefizz after the portfolio review, since cash and short-duration holdings would cover less than the household's preferred reserve of at least 18 months of core spending in lower-volatility assets while care costs are uncertain.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s review showed cash and short-duration holdings would cover less than the household’s preferred care reserve after adding the current agency schedule. The agreed follow-up is to prepare a liquidity plan after the portfolio review by 2026-08-30.

tickets.title: Prepare respite placement decision support
tickets.text: Prepare a financial comparison of the Thimble Harbor Assisted Living respite suite, quoted at $7,850 per month plus a $1,200 one-time assessment fee, against expanded in-home shifts so the family can respond before the suite hold expires.
tickets.evidence: Thimble Harbor Assisted Living is holding a respite suite only briefly, and the family wants a financial comparison with expanded in-home shifts before responding; the agreed follow-up is to prepare respite placement decision support by 2026-08-26.

tickets.title: Provide information for tax estimate
tickets.text: Send Jasper Copperwisp of Pocket Lantern Tax Partners the projected home-care, adult day, respite, mileage, and caregiver-payment amounts for Nadia and Owen Pebblefizz before year-end tax planning assumptions are updated; their 2025 return showed adjusted gross income of $214,000 and itemized medical expenses of $18,600.
tickets.evidence: The family wants the CPA to see projected home-care, adult day, respite, mileage, and caregiver-payment amounts before year-end tax planning assumptions are updated; the agreed follow-up is to provide information for the tax estimate for medical and caregiver costs by 2026-09-08.

tickets.title: Update health-care authority documentation
tickets.text: Obtain updated health-care authority documentation for Nadia and Owen Pebblefizz, replacing the unsigned older medical powers of attorney in the portal file and adding a current HIPAA release for Matteo Pebblefizz, who organizes electronic bills and insurance notices once a month.
tickets.evidence: The portal file has unsigned copies of older medical powers of attorney and no current HIPAA release for Matteo, even though he is organizing electronic bills; updated health-care authority documentation remains needed.
